history.text: Settled for the offer pricing bug: add setup validation so a bad price can never be configured, AND keep a checkout safety backstop that rejects a bad price at purchase. Both ship together.
Understood: setup validation plus the checkout backstop, both required.
Start with the checkout backstop tests; setup validation comes after that.
